Ajaymon, product designer

I’m Ajaymon, a product designer and design engineer. I take apps from the first flow to the App Store listing, including Goals, which went on to join Founder University and Google Cloud’s startup programme. Some of my favourite work is just below.

Since 2022, I’ve designed for teams in Dubai, United Kingdom, the US and Nigeria , at Carril, Trouve and now Studio Hemis. I come from an engineering background , so I care how things work as much as how they look.

These days I design in code as much as in Figma. When I’m not at my desk, you’ll probably find me at the gym , binge-watching a new series on Netflix or deep in some new tech that’s caught my curiosity. The best of what I find ends up in my playground.
